card.name: Cross-references to Warnings and Precautions
card.fires_on: The opening bracket, space or first letter right after the section name 'Warnings and Precautions' or 'Boxed Warnings' in a bracketed cross-reference. It is where a section number such as 5.1 is about to follow.

modes.label: Bracket after section name
modes.description: The opening parenthesis following 'Warnings and Precautions' in a [see ...] reference.

modes.label: Inside Boxed Warnings
modes.description: The first letter of 'Warnings' after the word Boxed.

card.writes: It pushes the model to produce the word 'warning' and its translations.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a label's [see Warnings and Precautions 5.x] cross-reference where the section number comes next.
